params.name: documentIds
params.description:
Target language IDs (the syntax is documentId_languageId), where documentId_languageId is a document ID
and languageId is a target language ID

params.name: mode
params.description:
Segment export mode:
Current - The current translation, the segment status notwithstanding (what is shown in the editor)
Confirmed - Confirmed segments at the specific stage, as defined by the StageNumber parameter. If the stage is not specified, export all segments confirmed at any stage (this behavior is similar to exporting files using the Smartcat interface)
Complete - Only completed segments, that is the segments that have passed all the stages and were confirmed at the last one

params.name: stageNumber
params.description: Workflow stage number when downloading an intermediate result

params.name: exportingDocumentFormat
params.description: Exporting file format for export without using source file

params.name: structuringDelimiter
params.description: Delimiter for structuring keys when exporting without using the source file
